purpose: Operational source routing for AutoStop/Автоспорт service management in Krasnoyarsk.

sources.name: Drom Parts
sources.verification: Search exact OEM, compressed OEM, model plus part name, and inspect seller city/photos.

sources.name: ZZap
sources.verification: Use exact OEM first, city filter where available, and all replacements view for analogs. Treat API as partner-by-request until contract is confirmed.

sources.name: ROSSKO / Росско
sources.verification: High-priority source when AutoStop account/API keys are available; confirm warehouse, pickup, price type, and return terms.

sources.name: ARMTEK / Армтек
sources.verification: Use only account-approved ETP/API or exported price list; confirm Krasnoyarsk logistics and return terms.

sources.name: Autopiter / Автопитер
sources.verification: Use for Russia-wide закупка and supplier comparison; wholesale/API access requires registration and account approval.

sources.name: AutoEuro API / АвтоЕвро
sources.verification: Use after API activation only; good candidate for normalized price, stock, delivery, and order-status checks.

sources.name: PARTSAPI.RU
sources.verification: Use for fitment and cross-reference enrichment, not as закупочная цена unless a connected supplier price is confirmed.

sources.name: UMAPI
sources.verification: Evaluate for supplier price-list exchange and catalog enrichment; confirm connected suppliers before using prices.

sources.name: Mikado Webservice
sources.verification: Use as an additional API candidate after commercial access is confirmed.

sources.name: AutoSputnik / Автоспутник API
sources.verification: Use after supplier login and current API endpoint are confirmed; legacy docs mention migration.

sources.name: APEC API
sources.verification: Use as import/Russia-order benchmark if commercial account and delivery route are relevant.

sources.name: AUTOPOISK
sources.verification: Use for professional catalog/cross/OEM enrichment and supplier-market context, not direct закупка until connected supplier prices are verified.

sources.name: Пятая передача
sources.verification: Use for Krasnoyarsk fluids and common service materials; confirm live stock and package size.

sources.name: Liqui Moly Красноярск
sources.verification: Use as local fluids benchmark only when OEM approval/spec and package size are clear.

sources.name: Avito Parts
sources.verification: Treat as manual direct-site search; verify photos, article, seller, and return terms.

sources.name: Emex
sources.verification: Use account-specific city and delivery terms; compare exact article and analogs.

sources.name: Exist
sources.verification: Use VIN/catalog route first, then compare exact article price and delivery.

sources.name: Autodoc
sources.verification: Use as secondary supplier and cross-check; confirm city delivery and returns.

sources.name: Метро-Автодом
sources.verification: Call or check current stock; public site claims large local inventory.

sources.name: КрасDеталь
sources.verification: Use for VIN-based inquiry and local availability; confirm part number in writing.

sources.name: Porshenkras
sources.verification: Use for local stock checks; confirm article and return terms.

sources.name: Автопоставка
sources.verification: Use for used/contract Japanese parts; verify donor, condition, and warranty.

sources.name: hh.ru
sources.verification: Use live vacancy search; do not store candidate personal data in memory.

sources.name: SuperJob
sources.verification: Use as market context, not as payroll source of truth.

sources.name: Dream Job Salary
sources.verification: Use as public benchmark only; compare with hh.ru and internal output.

sources.name: Finder Salary
sources.verification: Use as public benchmark only; compare with current vacancy data.

actions: Check overdue cards and expired deadlines.
Check ready cars with unpaid due amounts.
Check parts-order and supply columns for blockers.
Journal important decisions and follow-ups.
memory_rules: Store durable operating rule only, not board snapshots.

actions: Normalize OEM, compressed OEM, vehicle, side, axle, and condition.
Check contracted supplier/API/price-list routes first when available: ROSSKO, Armtek, Autopiter, AutoEuro, Emex, Exist, Autodoc.
Use ZZap for price and replacement comparison, then PartsAPI/UMAPI/AUTOPOISK only for catalog/cross enrichment unless supplier price is connected.
Use AutoSputnik/APEC/Mikado as additional supplier API candidates after account and delivery terms are confirmed.
Use Drom and Avito for used, contract, rare, or urgent local offers.
Use Krasnoyarsk fluids/local suppliers for same-day consumables.
Call local Krasnoyarsk suppliers when same-day pickup matters.
memory_rules: Remember chosen supplier and reusable search heuristic only.

actions: Extract complaint and vehicle identity from CRM.
Route source-sensitive facts through the repair source catalog.
Build a technician diagnostic checklist before pricing parts.
Mark missing data explicitly in the card.
memory_rules: Remember only durable diagnostic patterns confirmed by the shop.

actions: Compare active card load by technician or column.
Track blocked cars separately from productive repair time.
Use market salary sources only as context.
Create follow-up tasks for hiring, training, or performance conversations.
memory_rules: Do not store candidate personal data; store hiring rules and role requirements.

actions: Make the next action visible in the card description or title.
Separate estimate requested, prepared, approved, declined, and needs-data states.
Set follow-up deadlines for client approvals and pickups.
memory_rules: Store only reusable communication rules, not full client records.

actions: Find ready cars with unpaid due totals.
Find orders with materials and no works.
Find cashbox transactions needing reconciliation.
Create owner-level tasks for unresolved payment blockers.
memory_rules: Do not duplicate cashbox ledger in memory.

actions: Normalize vehicle and exact labor operations.
Collect public Russia STO labor-only prices for comparable work.
Collect public norm-hours/labor-time mentions as a second plausibility layer when available.
Filter outliers, average valid quotes, and apply AutoStop +50%.
Use norm-hours to check complexity and overlaps, not as the primary price basis.
Return missing context when fewer than 3 valid quotes remain.
Keep the estimate read-only until the owner gives a separate ЗН write command.
memory_rules: Do not store full price lists; keep only durable pricing rules and short quote schema.

actions: Classify source and license.
Extract durable conclusions only.
Update the relevant playbook or source catalog.
Journal the update.
memory_rules: Never store raw manuals, full tables, or temporary search results.
